charge_description: having in his possession one two-pound weight and two half-ounce weights, all of which were deficient in weight
raw_record: Summary conviction of Thomas Newton of the township of Fylingdales for having in his possession one two-pound weight and two half-ounce weights, all of which were deficient in weight. Offence committed at Fylingdales on 18 June 1818. Case heard at a Petty Sessions for the division of Whitby Strand.
